description.en:
The AI agent configuration to update. This configuration is merged with the existing configuration of the instance. For more information, see the AIAgentConfig definition. The following parameters in AIAgentConfig can be updated:

- VoiceId

- EnableVoiceInterrupt

- Greeting

- Volume

- EnablePushToTalk

- UseVoiceprint

- BailianAppParams

description.zh:
智能体实例ID。

> InstanceId为智能体实例启动成功后，返回的唯一的Id。启动智能体接口，请参见[StartAIAgentInstance ](~~2846201~~)、[GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the AI agent instance.

> This unique ID is returned after the AI agent instance starts successfully. For more information about starting an agent, see [StartAIAgentInstance](~~2846201~~) and [GenerateAIAgentCall](~~2846209~~).

description.zh:
> 智能体模版配置。已废弃，请使用AgentConfig字段。

需要更新的智能体配置，和实例启动所使用的配置进行合并更新。详见[AIAgentTemplateConfig](~~2846193~~)定义。
支持更新AIAgentTemplateConfig中的以下参数：

- VoiceId（语音ID）

- EnableVoiceInterrupt（启用语音打断）

- Greeting（问候语）

- Volume（音量）

- EnablePushToTalk（启用按键通话）

- UseVoiceprint（使用声纹）

- AsrMaxSilence（ASR最大静音时间）
description.en:
> The AI agent template configuration. This parameter is deprecated. Use the AgentConfig parameter instead.

The AI agent configuration to update. This configuration is merged with the existing configuration of the instance. For more information, see the [AIAgentTemplateConfig](~~2846193~~) definition.
The following parameters in AIAgentTemplateConfig can be updated:

- VoiceId (Voice ID)

- EnableVoiceInterrupt (Enable voice interruption)

- Greeting (Greeting)

- Volume (Volume)

- EnablePushToTalk (Enable push-to-talk)

- UseVoiceprint (Use voiceprint)

- AsrMaxSilence (ASR maximum silence duration)

descriptions.zh: 允许输入智能体实例Id和配置来更新智能体的配置（比如音色等）。
descriptions.en: This operation updates the configuration of an AI agent instance, such as its voice.
